create_project.title: Create a project
create_project.description: Create a project from the projects dashboard and confirm that it's ready to use.
prerequisites: A registered account in the workspace
create_project.outcome: A new project that appears on the projects dashboard.
create_project.overview: A project groups related work inside a workspace. You create one from the projects dashboard by giving it a name.
create_project.done: Your project is ready and appears on the projects dashboard.

strings.enter_name: Enter a name for the project.
strings.verify_success: A success message confirms that the project is ready.
